tooltip.efw.doll.trauma_desc: §7When body is covered in blood to maximum, take doll into hands to awaken it: surges BPM, enters trauma frenzy for 15s (+50% melee damage). Melee kills extend by +2s, firearm kills by +1s.

item.efw.sedatives.desc: §7A jar of calming pills (10). The pulse settles on its own and spikes of it are five times smaller. Does not work against the doll.
speech.efw.coth.mild.4: Chills... and not from the cold
speech.efw.coth.bad.5: My head is about to burst
speech.efw.coth.worst.3: I hear them in my head
tooltip.efw.kawaii_ears: Cute animated ears. Worn in the head curio slot.
tooltip.efw.worn_olympic.desc: §7An old track jacket. The zip sticks, the cuffs are stretched out.
tooltip.efw.worn_ring.desc: A worn wedding ring. The gold has rubbed off on one side, as if it was turned on the finger for a long time.
tooltip.efw.worn_ring.effect_desc: §7Aim a gun and you will see your target's weak spot.
inspect.worn_ring.desc: A worn wedding ring. The gold has rubbed off on one side, as if it was turned on the finger for a long time.
tooltip.efw.chain_hook.desc: A rusty chain with a forged hook at the end. Heavy.
tooltip.efw.chain_hook.use_desc: §7Held in the left hand. Hold Use to swing it, let go to throw. A light creature is dragged to you, a heavy one drags you to it. Not with a gun in the right hand.
inspect.chain_hook.desc: A rusty chain with a forged hook. Heavy; the hands shake after it.
inspect.chain_hook.lore: Dragging in what does not want to come was always something you were good at.
The chain stays in the left hand
tooltip.efw.chain_hook.trick.combo.desc1: Pulled to the target or pulling it in,
tooltip.efw.chain_hook.trick.combo.desc2: you kick it, spring back, throw again
tooltip.efw.chain_hook.trick.combo.desc3: and dash straight through it striking
tooltip.efw.chain_hook.trick.combo.desc4: with your weapon, rolling out behind it.
tooltip.efw.chain_hook.trick.finisher.de: After the second run's roll you take up
a loaded shotgun from the hotbar, raise it
and fire at the target. Shot damage ×1.8.
